localScope.worktreeState: The shared worktree was already broadly modified. This slice changes ACIS scalar-curve projection, generated graph-preservation tests, the two plans, and this receipt only; no files were staged or committed.

evidence.peerObservation: The mutable docs.rs latest SAT typed-layout page describes straight-curve origin/direction and ellipse-curve center/normal/major-axis/ratio order. It is corroborative record-layout context only; it does not establish exact SAB 21800 tag encodings, is not an immutable release source, and is not normative format authority.
evidence.localFinding: The scalar curve reader used a scan-ahead token cursor. A malformed recognized 21800 curve could skip a field or remain silently unresolved rather than fail at its record.
evidence.scopeLimit: Strict ordering applies only to ACIS BinaryFile version 21800 and only to straight-curve and ellipse-curve parameter fields. Either recognized vector tag is accepted to preserve existing stream behavior. Other signatures/versions retain the legacy path; curve evaluation, trims, transforms, topology, and B-rep semantics are unchanged.

implementation.productionChange: Read two positional vector fields for straight curves and three positional vector fields plus a double for ellipse curves. Refuse a missing or shifted recognized field as InvalidModel, clear rooted output, and report the exact curve node.

Parser-fed valid SAB 21800 ellipse curve projects center, frame, and ratio.

Existing parser-fed straight/ellipse non-finite matrices and shared-root controls continue to run in the owning test.
assertions: Malformed streams remain valid at the generic SAB framing layer, isolating the curve field reader.
Both malformed rooted projections refuse with InvalidModel and clear pre-seeded output.
Both malformed failures identify the exact curve node.
Positive controls verify the expected scalar/vector fields survive the parser-model-projection path.
Both LocationVec and DirectionVec are accepted as vector tokens; strictness is positional, not over-specific about vector tag kind.
